--- revoke_on_all_views_in_default_schema.sql
REVOKE SELECT ON ALL VIEWS IN SCHEMA DEFAULT FROM ROLE role1

--- AST
&ast.Revoke{
  Privilege: &ast.SelectPrivilegeOnAllViewsInSchema{
    Select:  7,
    Default: 37,
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 55,
      NameEnd: 60,
      Name:    "role1",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
REVOKE SELECT ON ALL VIEWS IN SCHEMA DEFAULT FROM ROLE role1
